knownGaps: DOM-only benchmark injections are intentionally not treated as authoritative application semantics.
A page without a matching successful same-origin GraphQL state response fails closed.
The adapter describes records returned to the current page; it does not infer unreturned records or permissions.
A schema or record attribute that has no record-layout field is reported as lacking a UI route rather than exposed as actionable.
An unresolved localization token is not emitted as a semantic label; the adapter falls back to translated application metadata, visible option text, or a humanized authoritative field name.

Relationship-picker comboboxes, query inputs, canonical executable options, and selected values retain the parent authoritative field identity and are prioritized as editable choices; non-actionable option descendants remain context rather than interaction Bindings.

Relationship query text is exposed only as query state, never as the selected business-field value; a nonempty query remains transaction-scoped and suppresses commit across local visibility changes until application state verifies a post-query selected-identity transition, observes a matching canonical candidate activation, or declares cancellation. A pre-query selected value is not completion evidence.
Fail-closed snapshots retain the complete versioned semantic-quality schema with explicit zero counts, so infrastructure and semantic-quality failures remain distinguishable.
Mutation execution is outside the read-only bridge; capabilities describe compatible host-resolved operations, never permission grants.
